propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue submits status as a field edit via issue.update(fields=...) instead of routing it through transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to reject the status since it is not an editable field and can only be reached through a workflow transition

The Cloud transport (JiraAcli) implements status-to-transition routing in acli.py:182-183, but the Data Center transport lacks this routing despite both paths calling the same dispatch code that passes status in the kwargs

Outbound status mutations fail silently on Data Center with the issue status remaining unchanged, while the same mutations work on Cloud, because the per-transport routing is implemented only once and the second transport did not receive it

The fix routes Data Center outbound status changes through transition_issue_by_name (which since bug 7f93 resolves either a transition name or destination status name) and never submits status through issue.update(fields=...)

Illegal transitions (either absent from the workflow or rejected with HTTP 400) must remain non-fatal and produce observable bridge_alerts records rather than propagating as fail-fast errors, to match the existing soft-failure contract and prevent one unexpected issue state from aborting the entire reconciliation batch
